compatibility_reanalysis_route.source: public Compositae1061 reference plus PRJNA957074 and other source-backed East Asian nuclear reads
compatibility_reanalysis_route.claim_limit: The original public Compositae1061 HybPiper reference is now source-validated and can support a clearly labelled compatibility reanalysis. Moreyra et al. 2025 added Cirsium tioganum recovered exons; that augmented reference and the exact retained 350-locus set remain unrecovered, so this route is not an exact reproduction.

claim_limit: This contract blocks empirical ER/ARD/Mk transition-rate fitting until both the colour-atlas state gate and a defensible branch-length nuclear tree route exist. Recovery of the original Compositae1061 reference removes one upstream compatibility-reanalysis blocker but does not itself create a branch-length tree.
